findings.title: Free shipping threshold condition is incorrect
findings.explanation: The ticket requires orders of $100 or more to ship for free, but the implementation only grants free shipping when the total is greater than 100, excluding orders exactly equal to $100.

evidence.quote: Orders of $100 or more ship for free.

limitations: The supporting code defining SHIPPING_FEE and any related context was not provided, so we cannot assess other aspects such as import correctness or naming consistency.
